_comment: Which speech-to-speech release CLARA is built and tested against. install.ps1 clones exactly this ref, so every install is identical. Upstream main takes ~55 commits a week and is not stability-tested on Windows - always pin to a tag. Change it with utilities\update-upstream.ps1, never by hand.
notes: Tested on Windows 11 + RTX 5080 Laptop, cu130. Parakeet TDT + Qwen3-TTS, smart turn on.
